note: Owner-editable summons and companions (owner 2026-09-27: 'might as well do the summons too'). Read when a fight's characters are compiled, so a change shows up in the next fight. 'sources' says which ability brings which creature: arrives 'start' (already with the summoner when the fight begins: rituals that last until destroyed, a manifested spirit, tamed beasts) or 'action' (the ability itself calls it mid-fight). A summoned creature acts right after its summoner's turn. command 'bonus_action': one Bonus Action of the summoner commands every one of that group within command_range_ft to take one action from its stat block this round; uncommanded, it takes the Dodge action. command 'free': it needs no command (Tame: 'Giving ordinary commands requires no Action'). Numbers may be formulas of pb, cl, key (the summoner's key ability modifier) and atk (the summoner's Cultivation attack modifier). 'improvements' are talents that change a creature. 'beasts' are the ordinary creatures a Tamer can train; 'tamer_default' is used until the owner picks. 'lifetime' is optional; 'ends_with_summoner' removes an opted-in creature at the next turn boundary after its summoner is defeated. Set it only when explicit rules or owner authority require that ending. No current source opts in: Corpse Servant's 'Until destroyed or dismissed' does not mean until its summoner is defeated. Missing policy leaves the creature's printed duration, destruction and concentration rules unchanged, including in older saves.

mount_note: The Rider Package (Skillful Riding) rides a willing mount: the fight starts with the rider mounted on this beast (a Large one: 2x2 squares) unless the sheet picks none (mount = empty).
